input: Analyze /var/log/app.log and produce a count per log level (INFO, WARN, ERROR). Print each as 'LEVEL: N' on its own line.

tool_calls:
for level in INFO WARN ERROR; do
    count=$(grep -c "^$level" /var/log/app.log)
    echo "$level: $count"
done
